_doc: Bottleneck rules, evaluated per team. See PHASE_4_PROMPT.md section 5.

rules.name: Staffing blind spots
rules.source: team Phase 4 prompt (Veloran starter rule): more than 1 unplanned bench hour per billable person-week

rules.name: Status reporting
rules.source: team Phase 4 prompt (Veloran starter rule): status hours above 5% of contracted hours

rules.name: Timesheets rebuilt from memory
rules.source: team Phase 4 prompt (Veloran starter rule): over 40% of Monday-Thursday entries made Friday or later

rules.name: Flow delays
rules.source: team Phase 4 prompt: flow efficiency below 0.30. The P90 wait limit of 5 days is a placeholder awaiting team confirmation
